note: Minimally developed Flathead NF campground (FS name Graves Creek, also known as Graves Bay) near the west shore of Hungry Horse Reservoir off Road 895; fishing access nearby, and Graves Creek Trail #1 leaves from near the campground. For conditions call Hungry Horse-Glacier View RD. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated April 10, 2025) confirms free, 3 sites, 22-ft max trailer, vault toilet, no potable water; added 16-day limit.
